name: Constraint removal
intent: Break fixation by removing the thing the human is protecting.
when: stuck, over-optimising, or when we can't because dominates
prompt: It is impossible to {constraint}. Design anyway.
readback: The surviving idea is usually the real one; the removed-constraint thinking is often the innovation.

claims.claim: Impasses in problem solving are overcome when the solver relaxes a self-imposed constraint on the solution, so deliberately removing a constraint makes new solution paths available.
Separating idea generation from evaluation, with judgement deferred until generation is done, increases the number of ideas without reducing, and sometimes increasing, the number of good ones.

grounding.helps: when an unexamined assumption is blocking every option; dropping a self-imposed constraint breaks impasses in puzzle studies, but removing a real constraint on purpose has not been tested
grounding.backfires: when the constraint was doing useful work: constraints can raise creativity as well as lower it, and an idea designed without the constraint may not survive its return
